sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球跨境基金设立第一大国、超大型跨国投资架构

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale Remarketing of Secondhand Hydraulic Earthmovers and Rollers

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Luxembourg's extensive network of over 80 active Double Taxation Agreements, including with Germany, France, the Netherlands, Belgium, the United States, China, Hong Kong and Singapore
Belgium-Luxembourg Economic Union bilateral investment treaties as applied to Luxembourg
European Union free trade agreements and association agreements applicable to Luxembourg, including the EU-Japan Economic Partnership Agreement and the EU-Singapore Free Trade Agreement

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law of 12 November 2004 on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing, as amended; Law of 13 January 2019 establishing the Luxembourg Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE); Law of 10 August 1915 on commercial companies, as amended; CSSF Regulation No 12-02 of 14 December 2012 on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of passport or national identity document of each direct shareholder and manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent state authority in the holder's country of origin or residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for states party to the 1961 Apostille Convention; otherwise Consular Legalization by the Luxembourg Embassy or Consulate in the state of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing / official extract from the commercial register of each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country company registry or competent regulatory authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the instrument is issued under the 1961 Convention; otherwise Consular Legalization by the Luxembourg Embassy or Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the constitutional documents and articles of association of each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country company registry or notary public of the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization, as applicable to the issuing state

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney for the Luxembourg notary or incorporation agent, if signed outside Luxembourg
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the jurisdiction where the power of attorney is executed
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for notarized instruments issued in an Apostille state; otherwise Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank confirmation or source-of-funds certificate for the share capital contribution and initial working capital
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Account-holding bank of the beneficial owner or shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank-authenticated letter, supplemented by notarized certification and Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization when required by the Luxembourg notary or AML obliged entity

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence under the Law of 12 November 2004 and CSSF Regulation 12-02. All UBOs, directors, shareholders and material counterparties must be screened against the UN Security Council sanctions lists, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, the EU terrorist list, Luxembourg Financial Intelligence Unit (CRF) red-flag indicators, and PEP databases. Where USD or GBP payment rails are used, OFAC and HMT UK sanctions filtering must also be applied by the Luxembourg collecting bank and by the correspondent banks handling Swift L/C transactions.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) - Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) online portal: https://www.lbr.lu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Filings are made in French; the notarial deed may be drafted in French, German or Luxembourgish. Non-Latin-script shareholder names must be transliterated into Latin script according to the Luxembourg registry's romanization standards. The corporate name must contain the mandatory legal-form suffix 'SARL' or 'Société à responsabilité limitée' and must not be misleading as to legal form, nationality or regulated activity.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Fonds d'investissement / Investment Fund / SICAV / SICAF
Bourse / Stock Exchange / Securities Trading Platform
Luxembourg / Luxembourgeois when creating a misleading sovereign connection
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Name clearance is requested electronically by a Luxembourg notary through the LBR/RCS portal before notarial signature. A successful reservation is valid for 30 days and cannot be automatically extended; the notary must re-file a new reservation if the deed is not signed before expiry. If the RCS rejects the name, the notary obtains the written refusal grounds and may submit a re-evaluation request to the registry with revised naming arguments. A formal administrative appeal lies to the Luxembourg Administrative Tribunal within three months of notification; the applicant must be represented by a Luxembourg avocat. During the appeal, a modified or wholly new name may be reserved immediately to avoid delaying incorporation.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted as the sole registered office for a used heavy-machinery wholesale SARL. Luxembourg law requires a physical registered office in Luxembourg. A licensed corporate service provider may supply a physical office, reception capability and registered-mail handling, but a purely virtual mail-drop service is insufficient to establish commercial substance for this medium-risk trading company.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate. Estimated 25-30% probability of an unannounced physical substance check by the Luxembourg RCS, tax administration or VAT authorities during the first three years of operation. The likelihood is heightened by the medium-risk AML tier applicable to used construction equipment trading, cross-border stock movements and Swift L/C payment flows. Annualized risk is approximately 8-10% after the first year once documented substance, local management and tangible business records are established.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Luxembourg notarial tariff for incorporation of a SARL, prevailing market benchmark for a single-member limited-liability company

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate legal publication in the electronic registry public dataset, formerly Mémorial C / RESA

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official publication tariff per corporate notice
No statutory filing fee; mandatory online declaration processed through the RBE platform

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille or consular legalization of foreign corporate documents, including certificate of good standing, certificate of incorporation and constitutional documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Home-country competent authority and Luxembourg Embassy or Consulate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-document apostille tariff and consular legalization fee, estimated for two to three corporate shareholders

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per page / per line, plus notarial certification of translation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Physical registered office service for the first contract year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing annual market benchmark for a physical Luxembourg registered office, RCS correspondence handling and statutory mail reception

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO, PEP and sanctions screening package covering all shareholders, directors and beneficial owners

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per natural-person UBO / director screening file, including OFAC, UN, EU and PEP list checks

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate bank account pre-application KYC / AML file preparation and source-of-wealth documentation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Luxembourg law firm or corporate agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for preparing bank onboarding files for a medium-risk used-machinery trading SARL

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended (Loi du 10 août 1915 concernant les sociétés commerciales), notably as modernized by the Law of 10 August 2016; Société à Responsabilité Limitée (SARL) provisions at Articles 710-1 to 710-25; complemented by the Law of 19 December 2002 on the Trade and Companies Register and the Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (RESA).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) de Luxembourg, administered by Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) under the judicial supervision of the District Court of Luxembourg (Tribunal d'arrondissement de Luxembourg).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarial Deed of Incorporation (Acte constitutif notarié) containing the Articles of Association (Statuts), filed electronically with the RCS and mandatorily published in the Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (RESA).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum subscribed and fully paid-up capital of EUR 12,000 for a standard SARL; cash contributions must be deposited prior to notarization with a Luxembourg credit institution into a blocked escrow account (compte bloqué) opened in the future company's name, evidenced by a blocking certificate (attestation de blocage) delivered to the notary; contributions in kind require a valuation report by an approved réviseur d'entreprises; the SARL-S simplified variant allows EUR 1 capital but is outside the standard formation here.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: UNANIMOUS WRITTEN RESOLUTION OF THE SOLE SHAREHOLDER AND THE FIRST MANAGER OF [COMPANY] S.À R.L. The Sole Shareholder hereby: (1) approves the draft Articles of Association annexed hereto; (2) subscribes and fully pays the share capital of EUR 12,000 in cash, evidenced by the blocking certificate of the depositary bank; (3) adopts the registered office at [address], Luxembourg; (4) appoints [Name], with sole signature authority, as First Manager (Gérant) for an unlimited term; (5) authorizes the Manager to represent the Company before the Trade and Companies Register (RCS), the tax and social security authorities, and to complete all incorporation and publication formalities; (6) resolves to open bank accounts with the depositary bank. This resolution is effective upon signature.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate name availability search and preliminary verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: RCS / Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) — online database at lbr.lu and the eJustice portal of the Luxembourg Ministry of Justice
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Search the RCS database and the Luxembourg/European trademark registers for identical or confusingly similar names; confirm the required corporate suffix 'S.à r.l.' in the proposed denomination; optionally apply to the RCS for a name reservation or blocking attestation; obtain a negative certificate of name availability prepared with the assistance of the notary.
required_dossiers: RCS name reservation/availability request form
Draft Articles of Association showing the proposed corporate name
Identity documents of the founding shareholder and the first manager
Declaration of the proposed registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name conflicts with an existing RCS registration or a protected trademark, submit an amended distinctive name via the notary; an unjustified registration refusal may be challenged in summary proceedings before the President of the District Court of Luxembourg within 15 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and legal drafting of the deed of incorporation by a Luxembourg notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg civil-law notary (Notaire), member of the Chambre des Notaires du Luxembourg
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the notary with the corporate object, share capital, share classes, managers, duration and registered office; the notary verifies the legal capacity and regulatory eligibility of the founders, checks criminal-record obstacles, and drafts the deed in French; circulate the draft among founders and finalize clauses on share transfer restrictions, management powers and distribution rules.
required_dossiers: Completed notary instruction questionnaire and defined corporate object
Passport or national identity card of each shareholder and manager
Recent criminal record extract for each manager
Proof of residential address for each natural person
Draft Articles of Association
Bank blocking certificate if already obtained
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary raises a query concerning incomplete KYC evidence or an unlawful corporate object, supply apostilled originals within 5 business days; drafting remains suspended until the file is complete, after which the deed is finalized without resetting the notarial fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit of the minimum share capital in a blocked escrow account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg credit institution duly licensed by the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a blocked formation account (compte bloqué) in the name of the future company with a Luxembourg bank; deposit the full EUR 12,000 cash capital by wire transfer from the founder's own account; instruct the bank to issue a blocking certificate (attestation de blocage) addressed to the notary and stating the deposit date, account holder and amount; if contributions in kind are planned, mandate an approved réviseur d'entreprises to value the assets.
required_dossiers: Bank KYC/AML forms including the beneficial ownership declaration
Copy of the draft deed or notary's cover letter
Identification documents and proof of source of funds of the subscriber
Account-opening instruction or power of attorney for the formation account
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests additional AML or source-of-wealth evidence, provide bank statements and a written source-of-funds declaration; the blocking certificate is re-issued within 2 business days after clearance and forwarded to the notary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the notarial deed of incorporation and signature of the statutes
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notarial study of the same Luxembourg notary in the district of the District Court of Luxembourg
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene all subscribing shareholders in person or by notarized power of attorney at the notary's study; the notary reads the deed aloud, verifies full payment of capital against the blocking certificate, collects the signature of the first manager and controls the lawfulness of the corporate object; the deed is executed in a single notarial minute and constitutes the constitutive act of the company.
required_dossiers: Final notarial deed and Articles of Association
Bank blocking certificate
Identity documents of all signatories
Notarized powers of attorney for any absent founder
Declaration of beneficial owner for the national register of beneficial owners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a signatory fails to appear or the blocking certificate is not final, adjourn the execution and cure the defect by proxy or by renewed bank certificate; material errors discovered after signature are corrected by a rectification act (acte rectificatif) executed before the same notary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the Trade and Companies Register (RCS) and publication in the RESA
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) administered by Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR); publication in the Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (RESA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary electronically files the certified copy of the incorporation deed, the blocking certificate and the appointment of managers with the RCS within one month of execution; the RCS assigns the corporate registration number (B number); the deed is published in the RESA; the company acquires legal personality only upon this publication.
required_dossiers: Notarial incorporation deed (original or certified copy)
Bank blocking certificate annexed to the deed
Identities and signatures of the appointed managers
Proof of registered office (lease title or owner's consent)
RCS application form filed through the LBR e-filing platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS registrar issues a query or provisional refusal, the notary cures it with a supplementary filing or a corrective addendum; a judicial refusal may be appealed in summary proceedings before the District Court of Luxembourg within 15 days of notification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-registration fiscal, social-security and commercial-establishment formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDTV); Centre commun de la Sécurité sociale (CCSS); Ministry of the Economy — Directorate General for SMEs for the business establishment authorization
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply to the AEDTV for the Luxembourg VAT number and, if the company carries on a commercial activity, request the autorisation d'établissement from the Ministry of the Economy; enroll the company and any employees with the CCSS for social security; notify the commune of the place of business and open the operational corporate bank accounts required for the used-machinery trading activity.
required_dossiers: RCS extract (registration certificate)
Notarial deed and RESA publication copy
Establishment permit application with criminal record and professional experience of the manager
VAT registration form submitted online via MyGuichet or to the AEDTV
Lease agreement and commune occupancy declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the establishment authorization is refused, file an administrative appeal to the Minister of the Economy within 40 days; delayed VAT or social security registration is cured by re-filing with the RCS extract and proof of publication; any administrative fine for late enrolment may be waived upon demonstration of force majeure.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of the Economy — Directorate General for SMEs (Direction générale des classes moyennes et PME) as the reference authority for the general business establishment permit under the Law of 2 September 2011; no sector-specific industrial license applies to ISIC 4659 wholesale of used construction machinery.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorisation d'établissement (Business Establishment Permit); if the company operates exclusively as a cross-border wholesale trader without local premises, registration as a commercial merchant with the RCS suffices and the establishment permit is limited to occupational safety clearances.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Administration de l'environnement (Luxembourg Environment Agency, Ministry of the Environment, Climate and Biodiversity)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from formal EIA — the storage and wholesale resale of used construction excavators (ISIC 4659) does not fall under Annex I or Annex II of the Law of 15 May 2018 on environmental impact assessment; no Class I or Class II environmental operating permit is required provided the site carries out no mechanical reprocessing, painting, dismantling or washing of machinery.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial point-source process discharges and no VOC abatement thresholds are triggered by pure warehousing and trading; any degreasing or washing of machinery must respect municipal sewer discharge parameters of pH 6.5-9.5 and mineral oil index not exceeding 5 mg/l (EN 9377-2); drained hydraulic oils, spent batteries and obsolete machine parts must be classified under European Waste Catalogue codes (e.g. EWC 13 01, 16 01, 17 04) and transferred only to licensed waste operators in compliance with the Law of 21 March 2012 on waste management and Regulation (EC) No 1013/2006 on waste shipments.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification for commercial warehousing and office premises issued by the Corps grand-ducal d'incendie et de secours (CGDIS) after a structural load inspection and the commune's occupancy permit; workplace clearance from the Inspection du travail et des mines (ITM) covering occupational health and safety, fire extinguisher placement, emergency evacuation signage and the safe handling of residual hydraulic fluids in stored equipment.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD) for direct taxes; Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) for VAT; portal: myguichet.lu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Luxembourg SARL automatically receives its corporate tax number (matricule) at commercial registry incorporation via the RCS and ACD. For VAT, file Form 645 with the AEDT or register electronically through MyGuichet. A non-resident entity without Luxembourg establishment must register directly for VAT with the AEDT before making taxable supplies; if it creates a taxable permanent establishment, it must also file for corporate income tax registration with the ACD and obtain a Luxembourg tax file number.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation (Luxembourg-resident SARL is taxed at entity level on worldwide income; no pass-through treatment)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Luxembourg has no check-the-box election; classification is statutory. Available elections include: (i) VAT group election (assujetti unique) under Article 60 of the VAT Law; (ii) fiscal integration for CIT among 95%-owned resident subsidiaries under Article 164bis CIR; (iii) option to tax real estate rentals under Article 44(1)(j) of the VAT Law; (iv) SICAR/SICAV transparent election where legally eligible.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (TVA) under Luxembourg VAT Law of 12 February 1979, harmonized with EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 35,000 annual taxable turnover for established small businesses (franchise d'affaires); EUR 0 for non-resident suppliers making taxable supplies in Luxembourg
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping regime. Electronic filing of periodic VAT returns and VAT listings is mandatory via MyGuichet/e-TVA. B2G e-invoicing through the PEPPOL network is mandatory; B2B e-invoicing is optional and requires recipient acceptance; Intrastat declarations apply when dispatches exceed EUR 460,000.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to exports of goods to third territories under Article 41(1) of the Luxembourg VAT Law when the seller, or a third party acting on its behalf, dispatches or transports the goods outside the EU and holds sufficient proof of physical export. Intra-Community supplies are zero-rated where the customer provides a valid EU VAT identification number and the goods are transported to another Member State. For used machinery, export zero-rating applies to the full sale price; alternatively the margin scheme may be used but cannot be combined with zero-rating on the same transaction.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (SAD / electronic exit declaration via Luxembourg customs systems)
Bill of Lading (or CMR or air waybill)
Inward Remittance Certificate evidencing FX repatriation
Certificate of origin where required by the destination country
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Zero-rating claims are subject to strict audit review. If export proof is missing, incomplete, or contradictory, the tax authorities reassess VAT at 17% plus late-payment interest of 0.6% per month and impose administrative fines up to 100% of the evaded VAT. Falsified customs or export documents trigger criminal fraud sanctions under Article 78 VAT Law and Article 1101 General Tax Law, including imprisonment up to five years and substantial monetary penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL), with the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF) acting as the competent authority for AML/CFT supervision, licensing of banks and payment institutions, and enforcement of financial-sector obligations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility within the euro area. Luxembourg maintains no general foreign-exchange control, no prior central-bank approval for capital movement, and no separate profit-remittance permit for an SARL. Current account and capital account transactions between Luxembourg and non-EEA states are presumed free under EU free-movement-of-capital rules. Profit repatriation to non-resident shareholders is subject only to ordinary Luxembourg corporate-law distribution requirements, the net-assets/balance-sheet test, and any applicable withholding tax or EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive relief. No mandatory FX conversion or central-bank allocation applies to foreign-currency balances held by the company.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory export-proceeds surrender timeline and no mandatory conversion ratio in Luxembourg. Foreign currency received from used construction excavator exports may be retained, converted, or hedged freely. The only obligations are statistical: resident companies may need to provide the BCL with balance-of-payments or external-transaction data and banks must make reporting filings; these are informational and do not constrain retention of USD or other currencies.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banque et Caisse d'Épargne de l'État (Spuerkeess)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility for EU-licensed fintech EMIs is High through the PSD2 EU passport, and Low for non-EU offshore EMIs. A regulated European Electronic Money Institution or Payment Institution may be used for lower-value operating disbursements while passported into Luxembourg under CSSF notification, but a full credit institution remains the recommended treasury rail for high-value secondhand excavator imports/exports, documentary credits, and trade-finance activity. Offshore digital EMIs without an EEA authorisation cannot legally provide payments or hold operational EUR accounts for a Luxembourg SARL and will typically be rejected as a compliance risk.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance of all directors is not an absolute statutory requirement. Luxembourg AML law and CSSF expectations permit remote onboarding using certified documentation, live video verification, digital identity proofing, and secure electronic signatures. In practice, for a non-resident-owned LU SARL in the used-heavy-machinery distribution sector, banks will generally require at least one live video interview, certified passport copies, a notarised board resolution, and updated RCS/UBO evidence. Some banks may require a physical visit to the branch or a local Luxembourg-based contact person where enhanced due diligence is triggered due to foreign directors or high-risk counterparty countries.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO opacity or nominee shareholding where natural-person beneficial owners are not clearly identifiable.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Luxembourg RCS extract, updated UBO declaration, shareholding chain diagrams, subscription documents, certified passports, source-of-wealth statement for each UBO, tax residency certificates, and bankers' reference letters from the UBOs' primary banks.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Over- or under-invoicing red flags typical of used excavator/earthmoving-machinery cross-border trading.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Comprehensive transaction dossier comprising purchase contracts, original commercial invoices, proof of payment instructions, transport documents (CMR, bill of lading, ocean/air waybill), customs declarations including HS codes, independent valuation or condition survey report for each secondhand excavator, and the full provenance chain from last owner to end buyer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Counterparty concentration in high-risk jurisdictions or involvement of sanctioned/embargoed entities.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Export/import compliance policy, EU and UN sanctions screening results for all counterparties and vessels/vehicles, details of commodity classification, proof that the equipment is not dual-use or military-capable beyond standard earthmoving use, end-user certificate where required, and a regulatory counsel opinion on jurisdiction-specific embargoes.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual payment pattern, including third-party settlement, back-to-back trades, rapid movement of funds between related accounts, or cash-advance requests from non-bank sources.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Contractual explanation of the trade economics, a full funds-flow map, signed tripartite agreements where third-party payments are legally necessary, board-approved internal controls over payment instructions, account statements showing consistent relationship with the funding bank, and historical execution records of six to twelve months.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Directors or UBOs with prior adverse corporate insolvency, enforcement history, or adverse media exposure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Criminal background certificates from country of residence, court extracts showing discharged or non-relevant insolvency, auditor's certificate of no undisclosed liabilities, detailed personal and corporate restoration narrative, and evidence of rehabilitation or compliance improvement, accompanied by legal counsel letter explaining any prior adverse history.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity capital for the Lu SARL should be routed through TARGET2/SEPA or SWIFT MT103 from the ultimate shareholder's own bank account to the SARL settlement account at a Luxembourg credit institution. The payment instruction must clearly cite the purpose as 'Equity contribution' and include the SARL corporate reference in the remittance information; the bank's payment form must be completed with the EU Balance-of-Payments classification for 'Direct Investment – Equity Capital' where applicable and any internal purpose code required by the receiving bank. The financing bank will require a notarised or privately executed capital-increase resolution, an updated share subscription statement, proof of the capital credit in local corporate books, updated articles/statutes if the registered capital is amended, RCS updating, and a source of funds narrative showing the original ownership of the cash. Wire transfers should not be split into artificial subpayments solely to avoid scrutiny.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound payments to non-EU sellers and buyers must use cleared institutional rails only: SWIFT MT103 corporate-to-corporate wires for supplier prepayments or settlement, and documentary letters of credit opened and confirmed by the Luxembourg bank for large lot shipments of used excavators/rollers. Commercial LC terms should be dominated by presentation documents (commercial invoice, full set of bills of lading/CMRs, packing list, insurance certificate, condition survey report, and customs export/import declarations) and should be handled by the bank's trade-finance desk. In the EU common payments area, low-value supplier disbursements may use SEPA CT, but secondhand heavy-equipment transactions should be kept within trade banking rails to preserve audit trail, sanctions screening, and payment provenance.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright FX forward contracts for EUR/USD or other liquid currencies
Non-deliverable forwards where the underlying currency is non-convertible or illiquid and physical settlement is impracticable
Cross-currency swaps for long-term balance-sheet or structured trade exposures
FX options and zero-cost collar structures to cap EBITDA exposure without sacrificing upside

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of annual accounts (comptes annuels) with balance sheet, profit-and-loss statement, notes and, if applicable, management report and auditors' report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers - Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), Ministry of Justice
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within seven months of the financial year-end; for a calendar-year SARL, by 31 July of the following year; for a non-calendar fiscal year, by the last day of the seventh month after the FYE
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: RCS issues a formal default notice for non-filing; continued non-compliance may be enforced by the court through per-day coercive fines and repeated consecutive annual defaults expose the SARL to administrative strike-off from the Luxembourg trade register (radiation d'office).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax return and net wealth tax return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar-year SARL: by 30 June of the following year, with e-filing extension to 31 December; non-calendar fiscal year: within six months after the close of the fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Omitted or late filing triggers taxation d'office, late-payment interest at 0.8% per month on outstanding tax, administrative monetary fines, and potential criminal prosecution for aggravated non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of beneficial owners (confirmation annuelle des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE), administered by Luxembourg Business Registers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than 31 March each year for data as at 31 December; any share transfer or ownership change must also be filed with the RBE within one month of the relevant change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit the annual confirmation may lead to administrative fines up to EUR 10,000, coercive per-day fines, and criminal sanctions against responsible officers for serious or repeated non-compliance.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory statutory audit by a réviseur d'entreprises agréé applies where a SARL exceeds at least two of the following three criteria for two consecutive financial years: balance-sheet total above EUR 4,400,000; net turnover above EUR 8,800,000; average number of employees above 50. Audit is also compulsory for public-interest entities, regulated financial undertakings, and medium or large companies.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP under the amended Law of 19 December 2002 on commercial accounts and annual accounts, implementing EU Accounting Directive 2013/34/EU; IFRS as endorsed by the EU is required for consolidated financial statements in applicable cross-border groups and permitted in other regulated circumstances.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SARL manager must reconfirm the identity, shareholding percentage, and nature of control of all beneficial owners in the RBE before 31 March each year. Share transfers or movements affecting beneficial ownership must be entered in the Register of Members immediately and reported to the RBE within one month of the change; the annual confirmation must align with the Register of Members, transfer papers, and RCS statutory records.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 - 2,500 per year for registered office/domiciliation services; USD 2,500 - 7,500 per year for full licensed corporate secretarial and annual filing management in Luxembourg.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 for audit-exempt small SARL; USD 5,000 - 18,000 for a trading SARL exceeding audit thresholds; USD 12,000 - 30,000 where consolidated financial statements or group audits are required.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 24.94% (2025: 17% CIT + 1.19% employment-fund solidarity surcharge + 6.75% municipal business tax in Luxembourg City; rate varies by commune)
